# Business Operations & Economic Moat Analysis: NVIDIA CORP (NVDA)
> **Filing Source**: SEC Form 10-K (FY2026) | **Primary Moat**: **Network Effects** | **Durability**: **Wide** | **Trajectory**: **Expanding**

## 1. Executive Summary & Revenue Architecture

The filing supports a balanced view of the business.

**Revenue architecture (filing-based)**: Hardware platform sales to OEMs, ODMs, CSPs and distributors, plus software licenses.

## 2. Segments & Disaggregated Revenue Architecture

- **Reportable segments (ASC 280)**: Compute & Networking, Graphics
- **Revenue lines (ASC 606)**: Data Center, Gaming, Professional Visualization, Automotive, OEM and Other

**Reportable segments (verified from the segment note)**[[1]](#cite-1)

| Segment | FY2026 revenue ($M) | % of revenue | YoY growth | Operating income ($M) | Margin | % of segment profit |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Compute & Networking | 193,479 | 89.6% | 66.5% | 130,141 | 67.3% | 93.4% |
| Graphics | 22,459 | 10.4% | 57.0% | 9,156 | 40.8% | 6.6% |

_Source: 10-K segment note (chunk `26b52a89-af2d-4d60-a78b-9846e216d374`); figures in USD millions as reported._

**Revenue mix (verified from the disaggregation table)**[[2]](#cite-2)

| Revenue line | FY2026 revenue ($M) | % of revenue | YoY growth |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Data Center | 193,737 | 89.7% | 68.2% |
|   ↳ Compute | 162,361 | 75.2% | 58.9% |
|   ↳ Networking | 31,376 | 14.5% | 141.5% |
| Gaming | 16,042 | 7.4% | 41.3% |
| Professional Visualization | 3,191 | 1.5% | 69.9% |
| Automotive | 2,349 | 1.1% | 38.7% |
| OEM and Other | 619 | 0.3% | 59.1% |

_Source: 10-K revenue disaggregation (chunk `40fa96f8-8f71-4703-b3b8-e81ae177bc64`); figures in USD millions as reported._

- **Data Center**: Rack-scale AI compute and networking platforms. _Drivers: Blackwell architecture, AI model makers._

| Moat Dimension | Assessment |
| :--- | :--- |
| Primary moat[[3]](#cite-3) | **Network Effects** (verified) |
| Secondary moats[[4]](#cite-4) | High Switching Costs |
| Durability / trajectory | Wide / Expanding |
| Compute & Networking[[5]](#cite-5) | Cost Advantage: Data-center-scale interconnect of compute nodes. |

**Moat rationale (filing-based)**: A growing developer base and installed base make the platform more valuable to each customer.[[3]](#cite-3)

**Business analysis data-quality notes**
- Secondary moat 'Intangible Assets / Brand' dropped: no verified filing quote evidencing its mechanism.
- Segment moat for 'Robotics' dropped: not a code-extracted segment or revenue line.
- 1 model-proposed product line(s) not in the extracted revenue table were dropped (Networking).

## 3. Economic Moat Deconstruction

Segment disclosure frames the revenue mix.

## 4. Competitive Threats & Counter-Evidence Stress Test

- Existing competitors and new entrants may offer lower-priced or better-performing products.[[6]](#cite-6)
- China-based competitors are favoured by the Chinese government.[[7]](#cite-7)

## 5. Market Power & Customer Concentration

- **Pricing power**: Cheaper competing products have lowered selling prices for some NVIDIA products.[[8]](#cite-8)
- **Customer concentration**: Two direct customers represented 22% and 14% of fiscal year 2026 revenue.[[9]](#cite-9)

## 6. Filing Evidence & Audit Trail
